name: showtail
description: Show your work: capture your AI coding prompts and edits (GitHub Copilot, Antigravity IDE) into a local provenance trail.

chatParticipants.name: showtail
chatParticipants.description: Record your prompt and drive Showtail (report, verify, status, trace)

commands.name: report
commands.description: Resolve a project and generate its Showtail report

commands.name: open_report
commands.description: Open the last validated report, or generate it once if needed

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Resolve a project and verify its Showtail trail

commands.name: status
commands.description: Resolve a project and show its Showtail status

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Show the provenance trail for a file (pass the path)

languageModelTools.name: showtail_project_control
languageModelTools.userDescription: Resolve the intended local project and run a Showtail report, open, status, or verify action.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool for Showtail report, open report, status, and verify requests. Pass selector only when it copies the student's project wording or an explicitly supplied trail ID/path. Never invent a filesystem path from the open workspace. The tool resolves locally, asks the student when evidence is ambiguous, and runs the control by stable trail ID or a validated explicit path when copied trail IDs require disambiguation.

action.description: The Showtail control action to run.

selector.description: Optional project wording copied from the student's request, or an explicit path/trail ID supplied by the student.

priorClaimId.description: Optional one-use claimId from a previous successful Showtail control. Reuses that validated project when selector is omitted; an explicit selector always wins.

showtail.binaryPath.description: Path to the showtail CLI (on PATH by default).

showtail.captureOnSave.description: Capture saved files through Showtail's local work ledger.
